My name is Tom and I has two brother. We lives in a small town near sea.
Every day I go to the school by bus. I like my teachers.
Yesterday I go to the park with my freind. The weather was very nice. We play football in the grass.

I like cook with my mother. She don’t like fish, but I love it.
english is my favourite subject at school. It’s a easy language for me.
